item.description:
Шукаємо розробника для створення та вдосконалення алгоритмів планування маршрутів і навігації з урахуванням геопросторових даних, особливостей місцевості та обмежень літального апарата.

 

Основні обов'язки:

  • Розробка та оптимізація алгоритмів планування маршрутів.
  • Реалізація алгоритмів пошуку шляху (A*, Theta*, RRT та аналоги).
  • Робота з геопросторовими даними, картами та цифровими моделями рельєфу.
  • Врахування особливостей місцевості та технічних обмежень літального апарата під час побудови маршрутів.
  • Тестування, аналіз та оптимізація ефективності алгоритмів.

 

Наші вимоги:

  • Досвід розробки від 2 років на C++ або Python (бажано обома мовами).
  • Сильний математичний бекграунд: алгоритми, оптимізація, теорія графів.
  • Практичний досвід реалізації алгоритмів планування шляху (A*, Theta*, RRT або аналоги).
  • Розуміння геопросторових даних: системи координат, проекції, GeoJSON, DEM та растрові моделі рельєфу.
  • Навички алгоритмічного мислення та вирішення складних технічних задач.

 

Буде перевагою:

  • Практичний досвід навчання нейронних мереж (PyTorch або TensorFlow).
  • Розуміння динаміки та обмежень літальних апаратів: радіус розвороту, енергоспоживання, вплив вітру, набір висоти.
  • Досвід у робототехніці, GIS, авіаційних симуляторах або GameDev (розробка стратегій, симуляторів та систем Pathfinding).
  • Досвід роботи з алгоритмами навігації та автономного планування руху.

 

Що пропонуємо ми:

  • Офіційне працевлаштування на основі Дія Сіті.
  • Бронювання і підтримка на кожному етапі оформлення.
  • Офісний формат (правий берег), ПН-ПТ.
  • Участь у розробці масштабного оборонного проєкту.
  • Власний спортзал, йога студія, масажний кабінет і кав’ярні.
  • Конкурентна заробітна плата із регулярним переглядом.
  • Чіткі та прозорі можливості для професійного розвитку.

 

Долучайтесь до команди Stellar Jet та зробіть свій внесок у розвиток технологій.

item.title: Backend (Python)/ Data Infrastructure Engineer
item.description:
Employment: Full-time
Work Format: Remote

About the Company

We are a technology startup operating in the Data Infrastructure and Cloud Analytics domain. We are developing a platform that helps companies optimize analytical query execution by automatically selecting the most efficient database or query engine based on speed, cost, and performance.

Our product brings together modern database technologies, cloud platforms, and distributed systems to make large-scale data processing faster and more efficient.

About the Role

We are looking for a Backend / Data Infrastructure Engineer to join the development of our product's core architecture.

You will work at the intersection of Backend Development, Database Technologies, and Distributed Systems, building solutions that integrate different data processing systems and optimize analytical query execution.

This role is a good fit for an engineer who is interested not only in traditional data processing workflows but also in database internals, query architecture, and distributed infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain backend services and APIs for interacting with different databases and query engines.
  • Build and improve integrations with Snowflake, DuckDB, Trino, ClickHouse, BigQuery, and other systems.
  • Develop mechanisms for SQL query routing, execution, and optimization across different query engines.
  • Work with SQL parsing, logical query plans, and SQL dialect transformations.
  • Ensure data consistency and result accuracy when executing queries across different systems.
  • Work with data storage technologies, including Apache Iceberg.
  • Develop automated benchmarking tools to test and compare different query engines in terms of execution speed, throughput, and cost.
  • Improve the platform's reliability, scalability, and performance.

Requirements

  • Practical experience in Software Engineering or Backend Development.
  • Commercial development experience with Python; experience with Rust is also a plus.
  • Experience working with databases, data warehouses, or analytical platforms.
  • Understanding of SQL and database architecture.
  • Hands-on experience with distributed systems.
  • Understanding of SQL query optimization principles and database performance tuning.
  • Understanding of ETL processes and data modeling.
  • Experience developing APIs, integrations, or connectors for working with different systems.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, DuckDB, Trino, or ClickHouse.
  • Experience with SQLGlot, Apache Calcite, Substrait, or SQL parsers.
  • Understanding of Query Federation, Query Routing, and Query Pushdown.
  • Experience with JDBC/ODBC, database connectors, or data migration between different systems.
  • Knowledge of Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi.
  • Experience with data consistency validation and cross-database result comparison.
  • Contributions to open-source projects in the Data Infrastructure domain.
  • Experience working in early-stage startups.

item.title: Middle Python (Django) Backend Developer
item.description:
Ми розробляємо бекенд на Django, Django REST Framework, Celery, Redis, Docker та MySQL. Сервіси тримають великий потік даних, інтегруються з платіжними системами та зовнішніми API. Цінуємо зрозумілий код, передбачувані процеси і розвиток у команді.

Обов’язки

  • Розробка та підтримка бекенду на Django REST Framework.
  • Проєктування, реалізація та підтримка REST API.
  • Інтеграція з платіжними системами: створення платежів, вебхуки, статуси, ідемпотентність.
  • Інтеграція із зовнішніми сервісами та провайдерами.
  • Фонові і періодичні задачі на Celery та Redis, з блокуваннями там, де задача не має виконатися двічі.
  • Робота з MySQL: ефективні запити, індекси, транзакції, розбір повільних запитів.
  • Оптимізація продуктивності API і запитів до бази на великих обсягах даних.
  • Написання unit-, інтеграційних і API-тестів.
  • Розгортання і підтримка сервісів у Docker.
  • Участь у code review.
  • Взаємодія з фронтендом, DevOps і Product Manager.

Вимоги

  • 5+ роки комерційної розробки на Python 3, з них не менше 2 років в одній компанії.
  • Впевнений досвід з Django та Django REST Framework.
  • Практичний досвід з MySQL: запити, індекси, транзакції, розуміння execution plan.
  • Досвід тестів на unittest і Django TestCase / APITestCase.
  • Досвід з Docker, Celery та Redis.
  • Впевнений Git і робота з GitLab.
  • Вміння писати простий підтримуваний код без зайвих абстракцій.
  • Розуміння REST, HTTP і базової безпеки вебзастосунків: автентифікація, авторизація, валідація вхідних даних, обережна робота з секретами.

Буде плюсом

  • Досвід інтеграцій із платіжними системами.
  • Досвід оптимізації сервісів із великими таблицями і високим потоком запитів.
  • Досвід із PostgreSQL.
  • Досвід CI/CD, бажано GitLab CI.
  • Розуміння асинхронності в Python.
  • Досвід моніторингу і логування: Sentry, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana.
  • Досвід опису API в OpenAPI / Swagger.

Ми пропонуємо

  • Конкурентну заробітну плату, що відповідає вашому рівню.
  • Роботу над технічно цікавими проектами з реальним впливом на архітектуру.
  • Команду, яка цінує якісний код, покриття тестами та професійний розвиток.
  • Оплачувану відпустку та лікарняні.
  • Прозорі процеси та адекватні дедлайни.

Процес відбору

  1. Ознайомлення з резюме та портфоліо.
  2. Технічна співбесіда з командою.
  3. Фінальна співбесіда
  4. Job Offer.

Як відгукнутися

Напишіть кілька слів про себе, додайте резюме та (за наявності) посилання на GitHub. Будемо раді познайомитися!

item.title: Lead Python Engineer
item.description:
📋 Role Overview

We’re looking for a Lead Python Engineer to join our team and support one of our US-based clients — a CRM and data intelligence platform for private-market investors.

You’ll run backend, data and AI as one function: lead a team of seven engineers who build the core platform, the data pipelines and the AI services, and set the technical direction for all three. You’ll report to the client’s VP of Engineering and work alongside the frontend, QA and DevOps leads. This is a hands-on leadership role — about half of your week will be technical work.

This is a full-time, long-term engagement with working hours of approximately 14:00–23:00 Kyiv time to overlap with U.S. Eastern business hours. Occasional out-of-hours incidents come with the role.

 

🧙‍♂️In this role, you will

  • Lead a team of seven backend, data and AI engineers across several time zones and own their planning, growth and delivery.
  • Merge backend and AI into one team with a single planning process, cross-train both sides, make AI delivery visible alongside everything else and grow an owner for each area.
  • Write design docs, make architecture calls, take on the hardest problems and take the first page when backend or AI breaks in production.
  • Own the backend platform architecture, database design and technology choices, pay down tech debt deliberately, and keep the platform reliable as customers and their data grow.
  • Define the canonical company model — how companies are identified and related, including entity resolution and search — and make sure customers can trust where every piece of data comes from.
  • Own enrichment pipelines and data partners for company, people and deal data, and catch quality gaps before customers do.
  • Put evaluation and quality controls around AI features so models and prompts can change safely, and own their accuracy, speed and cost.
  • Review tickets before they reach engineers, hold code review to a real standard and track defects per feature.
  • Make the engineering call on backend and AI incidents, drive blameless postmortems and keep a short, ranked tech-debt register tied to the roadmap.
  • Agree API contracts with frontend, shape scope with Product and explain the data layer clearly to customers and their security teams.

 

 

🎯You may be interested if

  • You want to own the core of a product end to end — backend, data and AI.
  • You are a hands-on leader who still enjoys building, not only managing.
  • You make decisions, write them down and see them through — and can disagree with a proposal without stalling it.
  • You’d rather build engineering practices that stick than inherit them, without slowing the team down.
  • You enjoy working with messy, real-world data and making it trustworthy.
  • You thrive in a remote work setup and appreciate autonomy in organizing your work.

 

 

👌 Role Requirements

  • 8+ years of professional backend development experience with Python, including deep Django and PostgreSQL experience.
  • Strong relational data modeling and a record of sound architecture and technology choices on multi-tenant SaaS.
  • 2+ years leading teams of 7+ engineers, with a record of growing people into owners.
  • Experience leading distributed teams across time zones, including engineers from engineering partners.
  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM features to real users (retrieval, extraction or agent workflows) and measuring them with evaluation sets.
  • Hands-on experience with entity resolution, record linkage or pipelines that reconcile conflicting data sources; clear understanding of data provenance.
  • Experience owning production incidents and on-call in your area.
  • Experience in a company with established engineering processes: you know which practices are worth keeping and can build them without slowing the team down.
  • Experience using AI-powered development tools, particularly Claude Code or similar coding agents, as part of the development workflow.
  • Clear communication: writing design docs and decisions for engineers, explaining trade-offs to product managers and walking customers and non-technical stakeholders through how the system works.
  • Advanced English (C1) or higher, including confident spoken and written communication.

 

 

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with private equity, venture or company data from sources like PitchBook or Crunchbase.
  • Experience building and running production systems on Azure.
  • Experience building search that blends keyword and semantic retrieval across large datasets.
  • Experience with event streaming or orchestration (Kafka, Airflow) and data quality tooling (Great Expectations, Monte Carlo).
  • Experience with Python AI frameworks, agent tooling and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
  • Experience building email or calendar integrations at scale.

 

 

💻 Working Conditions

  • Employment Type: Full-Time 
  • This is a fully remote position with the entire team across Ukraine.
  • Preferred working hours: approximately 14:00–23:00 (Kyiv time), aligned with U.S. Eastern business hours.
  • 20 working days of paid vacation per year.
  • Financial compensation for completing certifications and encouraging continuous learning and professional development.
  • High-impact role with clear visibility — you’ll own the backend, data and AI layer of the product end to end.

item.title: Senior Python Engineer

Adaptiq is a technology hub specializing in building, scaling, and supporting R&D teams for high-end, fast-growing product companies in a wide range of industries.
 

About the Opportunity

Our client is an international product company focused on advancing its technology platform and building innovative, scalable solutions.

The platform brings together multiple interconnected services, requiring robust architecture, seamless integrations, and efficient data processing. The engineering team tackles complex backend challenges, enhances existing functionality, and develops new capabilities while maintaining high standards of performance and reliability.

The company fosters a collaborative, ownership-driven engineering culture and actively integrates AI-powered technologies to streamline development and support ongoing product innovation.

You will have the opportunity to influence architectural decisions, participate in technical discussions, and take ownership of solutions from design to production.

  • Hands-on experience designing APIs, building integrations, and implementing service-to-service communication.
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies, such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, AWS SQS, or equivalent solutions.

  • Frontend development experience, particularly with Angular.
  • Exposure to cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, or platform engineering.
  • Previous technical leadership experience or an interest in growing into a leadership role.
     

Why Join Us?

  • Full accounting and legal support in all countries where we operate.

item.title: Computer Vision Engineer (Visual Place Recognition)
item.description:
About us

Farsight Vision converts flight footage into digital 2D and 3D twins for real-time intelligence in GNSS-denied environments, making analytics and situational awareness convenient and accessible while saving time and effort. We create multi-layered digital twins of terrain with dynamic tracking and object/landscape monitoring and predicting.


 

As a Computer Vision Engineer focused on Visual Place Recognition (VPR), you will own the models and pipelines that answer a critical question in the field: where are we? You will research, train, and ship VPR systems that work under viewpoint change, illumination shift, seasonal variation, and degraded imagery typical of real operations — not only clean academic benchmarks.


 

If you thrive in startup environments, are proactive, and enjoy turning research into reliable production systems, this role is a chance to shape core localization capability for a defense-tech platform used in live operations.


Responsibilities

  • Own Visual Place Recognition end-to-end: problem framing, dataset curation, training, evaluation, and deployment into the FSV Platform.
  • Design, train, and iterate on VPR models and retrieval pipelines — global descriptors, local feature matching, and hybrid approaches as the task requires.
  • Work with and extend modern VPR / visual localization methods (for example NetVLAD, MixVPR, CosPlace, EigenPlaces, AnyLoc, DINOv2-based descriptors, SuperPoint / SuperGlue / LightGlue-style matching) and know when classical or learning-based methods fit better.
  • Build robust training pipelines: data prep, augmentations for domain shift, hard-negative mining, loss design, hyperparameter search, and reproducible experiment tracking.
  • Evaluate models beyond top-line recall — failure modes under night, blur, compression, seasonal change, and map–query domain gap; define metrics that matter for field use.
  • Package and serve models for production inference (GPU and constrained / edge settings when needed), working with backend and MLOps on versioning, monitoring, and redeployment.
  • Collaborate with backend, geospatial, and field teams to integrate VPR into mapping, localization, and digital-twin workflows.
  • Use AI coding tools daily, and review, test, and stand behind every line and every model that ships.
  • Run small PoCs on new architectures or training recipes, measure them honestly, and bring the team a reasoned recommendation.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in computer vision / deep learning for real products or research transferred to production.
  • Strong Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch (or equivalent) for training and debugging vision models.
  • Proven experience with Visual Place Recognition, visual localization, image retrieval, or closely related geo-localization / SLAM-adjacent perception.
  • Ability to train and fine-tune VPR / retrieval models from scratch or from public checkpoints: datasets, losses, mining strategies, and evaluation protocols (e.g. recall@N, precision–recall under realistic splits).
  • Working knowledge of modern VPR and matching literature and the judgment to pick methods for viewpoint, appearance, and domain shift — not only recreate paper numbers.
  • Experience with large-scale feature indexes / ANN search (FAISS or similar) and practical retrieval system design.
  • Solid understanding of CNN and transformer backbones, representation learning, and metric learning.
  • Comfort debugging models and data issues that show up in the field (noisy labels, distribution shift, rare failure cases).
  • Experience in a fast-paced environment with high ownership and ambiguous requirements.

Nice to have

  • Published work or strong open-source contributions in VPR, visual localization, or image retrieval.
  • Multi-view geometry, SfM / SLAM, or photogrammetry experience (COLMAP, OpenMVG, etc.).
  • Geospatial stack: georeferencing, map alignment, GDAL, orthophotos, point clouds.
  • Model optimization for deployment: ONNX, TensorRT, quantization, distillation.
  • Video / sequential place recognition, temporal consistency, or map maintenance over time.
  • Experience with aerial / drone imagery and GNSS-denied or contested environments.
  • CUDA and GPU training at scale.
  • Defense tech or dual-use background.

Security Eligibility

Our platform is actively used by the Armed Forces in live operations. As an Estonian-Ukrainian defense technology company handling sensitive operational data, we have a responsibility — legal, ethical, and practical — to ensure the integrity of everyone on our team.


 

All candidates must be able to confirm the following:


 

  • Neither you nor your close relatives (parents, spouse, siblings, children) reside in Russia, Belarus, or temporarily occupied Ukrainian territories
  • You have no regular personal, financial, business, or professional contact with individuals in those territories
  • You consent to a deeper security verification if the process advances to later stages


 

If any of the above criteria are not met, please do not proceed with your application.

Why us

  • With us, you will become part of a team of professionals who strive to contribute to the development of advanced technologies.
  • We value teamwork and create an atmosphere of mutual support where everyone can unleash their potential.
  • Flexible work schedule.
  • Paid vacation and sick days.

AP US Tax Compliance and Advisory is a US tax firm based in Israel serving Israeli investors with US real estate and US citizens living abroad. Owner-run, growing, and building its own technology.

 

THE PROJECT

We prepare US tax returns in Wolters Kluwer CCH Axcess and have automated most of the preparation through CCH's REST API: import, calculation, printing, review memos, e-file qualification and release all run from code today. What runs in scripts must become a product before the 2027 filing season: a client platform where clients (or their AI assistants) complete a structured intake, the system extracts data from documents, prepares the return through CCH, routes it to a human reviewer and signer, collects an e-signature and payment, releases the e-file and delivers the result. The design document, data model, state machine, API and security model are written. You will be the first engineer and you will own the backend.

 

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Backend architecture and implementation: Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy/Alembic, Postgres, a job queue, workers, webhooks.

- The CCH Axcess API module as a server-side job runner: one in-flight job per return, global concurrency limits, exponential backoff on locks, idempotency keys, prompt handling, structured results, parked-job alerts.

- Security engineering: PII vault with field-level encryption (KMS), tokenized payload assembly, append-only audit log, RBAC with step-up MFA for sensitive actions, PII-free logging with a redaction layer, secrets manager, backups and restore tests.

- Integrations: Stripe (payments, webhooks), an e-signature vendor with identity verification, Google Drive, transactional email, WhatsApp Business API, Anthropic API for document extraction with human confirmation.

- Infrastructure as code on AWS (ECS Fargate or App Runner, RDS, S3, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) or an agreed managed platform; CI with tests and security scans; staging and production environments; runbooks.

- You work against a mock CCH server built from our specification; production runs are performed by the firm. You will never hold production credentials or see client data.

- Collaboration: a full-stack engineer on the portal and staff console; an AI assistant that writes specifications and reviews every pull request before the owner sees it; a weekly 30-minute call with the owner.

- After the build: a retained maintenance agreement including on-call during the filing season.

 

REQUIREMENTS

- 5+ years building Python backends in production, 2+ years as the person responsible for a system's reliability.

- Deep Postgres: schema design, migrations, transactions, indexing, point-in-time recovery.

- Integrations with unreliable third-party APIs: retries, idempotency, partial failure, long-running jobs with polling.

- Security habits: least privilege, secrets management, no sensitive data in logs, dependency hygiene. You can explain how you would design a system where the people who build it never see the data it holds.

- Docker; one major cloud; infrastructure as code.

- Clear written English; you document decisions and write runbooks without being asked.

- At least four hours of daily overlap with Israel (UTC+2); availability December 2026 through June 2027 at 30-40 hours per week.

 

NICE TO HAVE

- Fintech, payments, accounting, insurance or health-data experience; SOC 2 or ISO 27001 exposure.

- LLM API experience (Anthropic/OpenAI SDKs, tool use, structured outputs) or MCP servers.

- Experience with XML-heavy enterprise APIs.

- Russian or Hebrew (the owner speaks both; not required).

 

ENGAGEMENT TERMS

- Independent contractor (B2B) via Deel, Payoneer or Upwork; NDA, IP assignment and the firm's confidentiality agreement signed before access to any repository.

- Phase 1: December 1, 2026 to April 30, 2027, 30-40 h/week; USD 3,500-6,000 per month (or USD 30-45/h) depending on seniority and hours.

- Phase 2: May 2027 onward, retained maintenance 10-20 h/week plus on-call in season, priced separately.

- Access: development and staging only; no production data, no production credentials; mock CCH server and synthetic data.

- Remote; Ukraine, Poland, Georgia, Armenia, Serbia, Kazakhstan and similar time zones preferred. Not available to contractors located in Russia.

 

PROCESS

1. Written application with three short answers: (a) one third-party API integration you built that had to survive locks, rate limits or inconsistent responses, and what you did about it; (b) how you keep secrets and personal data out of logs in a system you run; (c) your availability December 2026 to June 2027 and your overlap with UTC+2.

4. References, contract, onboarding. Target start: December 1, 2026.

 

Apply with a CV or LinkedIn profile, links to code or systems you are proud of, and the three answers. Applications without the answers are not reviewed.

item.description:
We are a sports and entertainment representation database. Companies use it to find out who represents athletes and talent. We’re a small, data-heavy team, and our research team keeps hundreds of thousands of records current.

 

Our goal is to map the entertainment and sports industries: who represents whom, and how that changes over time. Our data is only valuable if it’s accurate, so accuracy comes before speed in everything we build.


*English needs to be good enough to have video meetings

 

The role
You’ll own two areas of work:

  1. Our internal Python apps. These include Django apps that power member-facing data on our WordPress site, such as a festival lineup database and sports agency market share data, plus a Flask research tool our team uses daily for roster processing and verification. You’ll maintain, fix, extend and deploy them.

  2. AI automations that save our research team time. For example, given a list of names, automatically find each person’s official social media accounts, the languages they speak, and other basic public information. Results come back with confidence scores, and a person reviews them before anything is saved.

     

 

Who thrives here
We’re a small company moving fast, and this role is for someone who wants that. You’ll be the developer on the team, not one of many, so what you build, fix or improve has a direct, visible impact.
 

  • Strong work ethic. You take ownership of your work and see it through. When something breaks or a deadline is close, you stay with it until it’s done. Comfortable with working weekends if thats what it takes.
  • Comfortable with pace and change. Priorities can shift week to week, sometimes because of a launch, a news cycle or a sports season. You adapt quickly without needing every detail planned in advance.
  • Self-directed. No one will hand you a perfect spec every time. You ask the right questions, make sensible decisions, and keep work moving.
  • Flexibility when it counts. Some deadlines, like a season launch or a major report, need extra hours, sometimes outside your usual schedule or on weekends. We need someone who’s willing to step up at those times.
     

How we work
We want a developer who thinks like an owner, not someone who waits to be assigned tickets. That means:
 

  • Contributing to the product. Give input on our goals and suggest better ways to reach them. If you see a technical way to map the industry faster or more accurately, bring it to us.
  • Taking initiative. Look for ways to move the project forward on your own: automating manual work, improving our tools, and fixing problems before they become ours.
  • Treating accuracy as essential. Our team verifies large volumes of data every day. Help us build processes and tools that keep data accurate at scale, with checks and safeguards rather than shortcuts.
  • Using AI with judgment. We use AI tools heavily and expect you to as well. Because AI writes much of the code, your judgment is the job: review everything before it ships, catch security and data problems, ask questions when a request is unclear, and push back when something won’t work. We are not looking for someone who passes our requests to an AI and ships what comes back.
